items.title: 66600_Teddy Wilson oral history interview
items.q: The whole period I was with Goodman, Harry was the bass player

ctx.x: Some of the bass players you played with in Benny Goodman's band, Harry Goodman, his brother was there?
Yes. The whole period I was with Goodman, Harry was the bass player, before I came in and after I left. And later, after I left, Annie Bernstein came in on bass. Great bass player.
